title: DuoJEPA: Cross-Modal Translation Between Unaligned Self-Supervised Embedding Spaces
first_author_affiliation: Kentucky Center for Digital Innovation, University of Louisville
code_status: 固定v1、arXiv资源及作者链接未找到DuoJEPA原作者源码仓库。
code_license: 未找到作者源码许可证；论文arXiv perpetual non-exclusive license
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.foundation_models.duojepa import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42, device="cpu"))'

cost_assessment.source: Fixed v1 Table 8 and Appendix A; https://arxiv.org/html/2611.15968v1#A1
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: Two 12-layer ViT-B towers plus translators: satellite 100k steps/batch256 on 2 H200 for 28h49m; radiograph/report 20k steps/batch128 on 2 H200 for 2h34m, plus ablations.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Explicit dual-H200 training time and multi-arm matrix exceed the short single-device budget; no weights, medical records or imagery are downloaded.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅实现目标空间CLS InfoNCE和单head图像skipless层及初始化。

summary: 两个encoder各保留自己的LeJEPA空间，单层无残差translator将表示映射进对方空间，InfoNCE在目标空间内计算且两侧都反传。本地保留单head图像层、正交/SVD初始化与CLS目标，不包含完整LeJEPA、patch项、分布式负例或预训练模型；完整实验高成本不复现。
